preconditions.description: The number of rows r must be between 1 and 500.
The number of columns c must be between 1 and 500.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' if r == 1 and c == 1 else True
postconditions.description: If r and c are both 1, output 0 as no diverse matrix exists.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i][j] <= 10**9 for i in range(r) for j in range(c))
postconditions.description: All elements of the matrix must be positive integers between 1 and 10^9.
The array b must contain r + c distinct integers.
The magnitude of the matrix is the maximum value in the array b.
